countedBy: lane #195 (opus) from the rectified NW panorama crop TMX7316010203-002374_pano_0003_000141 (artifacts/landmark-briefs/autopon/w01-330.jpg, 30.5 m wide, 48 px/m; the NE half of the curved front) and the Zocherstraat crop w02-158; ribbon convention (the 0.18 m fins and the red mullions merge, the 0.36 m thick piers do not separate cells either since every cell has its own framed window). Not a blind haiku count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: front (Overtoom, curved loggia grid), NE half
facades.note: Five loggia storeys (balustrades at photo y 740/590/445/295/150), 15 cells between the grid's NE end (x 210) and the 6th thick pier (x 1450), one red-framed window per cell. On the 2nd and 4th storeys the cells either side of every other thick pier (x 210, 705, 1210) are enclosed rooms with a forward window and no balustrade; they still hold one window each. The ground floor (two glazing tiers between the pilotis, the David Lloyd entrance) is not declared: its tiers are cut by the pilotis and the van, and are not countable to the row.

facades.name: Zocherstraat (south block), entrance and vitrine
facades.note: w02-158 (13.9 m, 50 px/m) starts at the glazed entrance at the west end of the second south run (9.8 m from the model's viewer-left silhouette edge, the stair tower). Bottom two rows: the entrance (photo x 0-45), a glazed door to about 2.4 m and a glazed transom panel above it behind a 0.3 m frame; the rest of the ground floor is closed white panels. Third row: the floating vitrine, one ribbon (its 0.24 m mullions merge under the ribbon convention). The balcony storeys above are not declared: the photo shows their back walls only as dark shadow, no countable glazing.
